Stale escalation note above is incorrect: the dep graph is correctly wired. Verified 2026-05-13 in PKIX-zkjb.2's do-beads run:
- .2 deps: (parent-child only) — ready
- .3 deps: (parent-child, .2 blocks, .6 closed blocks) — blocked on .2 only
- .4 deps: (parent-child, .3 blocks) — blocked on .3
- .5/.7 deps: each (parent-child, .3 blocks) — blocked on .3
- .9 deps: (parent-child, .3 blocks, .4 blocks) — blocked on both
- .8 deps: (parent-child, .5 blocks, .7 blocks) — blocked on both
The cascade .2 → .3 → {.4, .5, .7} → {.9, .8} is correct. The previous AI mis-read 'PKIX-zkjb.3 shows depends on .4, .5, .6, .7' — actual deps on .3 are only (.2 blocks) + (.6 closed blocks). Now that .2 is closed, .3 is the next ready leaf; .4 will surface naturally after .3 closes.
